name: The Azure Qiantang, a Luxury Collection Hotel
positioning: Luxury Collection hotel in Hangzhou on the bank of the Qiantang River, overlooking the tidal bore, with river-view rooms behind floor-to-ceiling windows
best_for: Travelers who want a riverside city base near West Lake and Six Harmonies Pagoda
Guests who want river views from their room

facts.text: The hotel is perched on the bank of the Qiantang River, overlooking the tidal bore.
The hotel is near Six Harmonies Pagoda, West Lake and Eight Diagrams Field.
The hotel provides access to the heart of Hangzhou.
The hotel has an indoor pool, a spa and a fitness center.
The fitness area includes a sauna, steam room and whirlpool alongside the indoor swimming pool.
Many rooms offer sweeping views of the Qiantang River; others overlook the hotel gardens.
The Presidential Suite offers extra space and Qiantang River views.
Panorama Restaurant has a front-row view of the Qiantang River and an outdoor terrace.
Lan Ting, on the hotel's 23rd and 24th floors, serves regional Chinese cuisine and has a tea bar with river views.
The hotel has a grand ballroom and seven meeting rooms.

highlights.text: The hotel overlooks the Qiantang River tidal bore from the riverbank.
Rooms have large floor-to-ceiling windows, and many look over the Qiantang River.
Room types include a Panoramic Suite with 270-degree views.
Bathrooms are expansive and marble, stocked with luxury toiletries and with tubs with spray jets.

considerations.text: Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport is about 25 km from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing typical of Luxury Collection properties.
